snippet.title: Grrr! Someone Took My Toy! 🧸 Don't Get Angry | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Grrr! Your brother took your toy and you feel so angry. What do you do?

A man once asked our Prophet Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) for advice, and the answer was: "Do not get angry!" The man asked again and again, and every time the answer was: "Do not get angry!" (narrated by Abu Huraira Radi Allahu Anhu)

So when you feel angry: stop, take a deep breath, and use kind words. Staying calm is what a strong Muslim does! Can your little one say: Yes, I can?

Source
• Sahih al-Bukhari 6116: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:6116
